title: Really big plastic punch bowl
text: Really big plastic punch bowl. This is plastic... but really pretty and it is HUGE.  Big enough for that 30 person baby shower or birthday party.  If it were glass it would weigh about 40lbs!  Because it's fairly light weight (but not too light) it would work for really big fruit or pasta or potato or green salad too.  For the price, my daughter and I are happy with this purchase.
